   298	      try {

    27	  if (cond) pass += 1;

    31	function deepFreeze(v) {
    32	  if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return v;
    33	  Object.freeze(v);
    34	  Object.getOwnPropertyNames(v).forEach(function (k) { deepFreeze(v[k]); });
    35	  return v;
    36	}
